description: Add missing Pro Vue components to web/src/: FileManager, HttpTTS, License, ActiveLicense, BookConfig, RemoteBookSourceSub. Wire them into Index.vue and Reader.vue with proper show/hide dialogs, event bus integration, and API calls matching the compiled JAR's behavior.
steps: Step 1: Create web/src/components/FileManager.vue - A file manager dialog component. Props: show, home, title. Model: prop='show', event='setShow'. Data: currentPath, fileList, keyword, fileSelection. Uses API endpoints: this.api+'/file/list' (GET with params path,home), this.api+'/file/upload' (POST multipart with path,home params), this.api+'/file/download' (GET with params path,home - opens in window), this.api+'/file/get' (GET with params path,home), this.api+'/file/save' (POST with {path,home,content}), this.api+'/file/mkdir' (POST with {path,name,home}), this.api+'/file/delete' (POST with {path,home}), this.api+'/file/deleteMulti' (POST with {path:[...],home}), this.api+'/file/importPreview' (POST with {path,home}), this.api+'/file/restore' (POST with {path,home}), this.api+'/file/parse' (POST with {path,home}). Features: browse files/directories, upload files, download files, create directories, delete files, edit text files, import books from files, restore from zip backup. Follow the same dialog pattern as LocalStore.vue but with richer file operations.

Step 2: Create web/src/components/HttpTTS.vue - HTTP TTS source management dialog. Props: show. Model: prop='show', event='setShow'. Data: localSelection. Uses API endpoints: this.api+'/httpTTS/list' (GET), this.api+'/httpTTS/save' (POST with TTS object), this.api+'/httpTTS/saveMulti' (POST with array), this.api+'/httpTTS/deleteMulti' (POST with array of selected items). Features: list HTTP TTS sources in table, add new, edit existing (show JSON editor dialog), import from file, delete selected. Follow the same pattern as ReplaceRule.vue component.

Step 3: Create web/src/components/License.vue - License management dialog. Props: show. Model: prop='show', event='setShow'. Data: license object {host,userMaxLimit,expiredAt,openApi,simpleWebExpiredAt}. Uses API endpoints: this.api+'/getLicense' (GET), this.api+'/importLicense' (POST with {licenseKey}), this.api+'/supplyLicense' (POST). Features: show current license info, import license key via prompt, request trial.

Step 4: Create web/src/components/ActiveLicense.vue - Active license list management for admin. Props: show. Model: prop='show', event='setShow'. Data: localSelection, filePath='data/activeLicense.json', list, loadingIndex. Uses API endpoints: this.api+'/generateLicense' (POST with license config). Features: view/manage active licenses, generate new licenses (admin only). Uses FileManager's parse API to load the activeLicense.json file.

Step 5: Create web/src/components/BookConfig.vue - Book-specific configuration dialog (PDF image width, reading config). Props: show. Model: prop='show', event='setShow'. Data: bookConfig with pdfImageWidth from current showBookInfo's readConfig. Uses API endpoint: this.api+'/book/saveBookConfig' (POST with book config). Features: edit reading-specific settings per book.

Step 6: Create web/src/components/RemoteBookSourceSub.vue - Remote book source subscription management. Props: show. Model: prop='show', event='setShow'. Data: localSelection, filePath='remoteBookSourceSub.json', remoteBookSourceList, loadingIndex. Uses API endpoint: this.api+'/saveFromRemoteSource' (POST). Features: manage remote book source subscription URLs, sync from remote sources.

Step 7: Update web/src/views/Index.vue - Import and register all new components (FileManager, HttpTTS, License, ActiveLicense, BookConfig, RemoteBookSourceSub). Add template usage with v-model bindings. Add data flags and methods: showFileManagerDialog(home, title), showHttpTTSDialog, showLicenseDialog/showLicense, showActiveLicenseDialog, showBookConfigDialog, showRemoteBookSourceSubDialog. Add downloadBackupFile method that opens window to this.api+'/user/downloadBackupFile'. Add clearInactiveUsers button (admin only). Add cacheBookOnServer functionality. Wire buttons in the settings/navigation area: '浏览书仓' button calls showFileManagerDialog('__LOCAL_STORE__','书仓文件管理'), '文件管理' button calls showFileManagerDialog('','文件管理'), 'TTS源管理' button, '许可证' button, '下载数据备份' button, '书源订阅' button. Use eventBus to emit/listen for dialog events following existing pattern.

Step 8: Update web/src/views/Reader.vue - Add TTS playback functionality using /book/tts endpoint. Add saveBookContent method that POST to this.api+'/saveBookContent' with {url, index, content}. Add TTS audio element and controls. Add BookConfig dialog integration so users can configure book-specific settings from the reader page.
acceptance_criteria: All 6 new .vue component files exist in web/src/components/
Index.vue imports and registers all new components
Index.vue template has dialog instances for all new components with proper v-model bindings
Reader.vue has TTS audio playback and saveBookContent functionality

All API endpoint paths match what the compiled JAR's frontend expects (/file/list, /httpTTS/list, /getLicense, /importLicense, /generateLicense, /book/saveBookConfig, /book/tts, /saveBookContent, /saveFromRemoteSource, /cacheBookOnServer, /clearInactiveUsers, /user/downloadBackupFile)
Components follow existing patterns: Element UI dialogs, mapGetters for dialog dimensions, Axios for API calls
verification: Run: cd /projects/sandbox/reader-dev/web && cat src/components/FileManager.vue | head -5 (verify file exists)
Run: grep -c '/file/list\|/httpTTS/list\|/getLicense\|/book/tts\|saveBookContent' web/src/components/*.vue web/src/views/*.vue (verify API calls present)
